dialog: Time to engage the enemy more closely!
I'm gonna really show you what's what!
Alright! I'll show you what's what!
I fight for Hijiri's ideals!
When you've drawn close to a ship's phantom/\n don't think you can sail on away freely.
You wandered too close!
I've got to smash you apart!
I'll settle the scores!
I'll sink you one way or another.
I won't let you sail on by!
It's too late to get scared now!
I'll show you how skilled I am!
Looks like I don't need to hold back!
I'll show you how heavy-handed I can be!
I'll make the impossible possible!
I've got to get the wind back in my sails!
I've got to settle this right here!
I'll drag you under with me!
You're gonna feel this one!
Take that!
If I can get in close...
Hah!
This is no ordinary ladle!
Hyah!
Dash in real fast/ and...
Ooryaa!
Vanish!
Bathe in cursed water!
I'll pull you under/ as ship phantoms do!
I'll wash you away!
I'll engulf you in a tidal whirlpool!
Even if there's no water around...
Time to finish it up with this baby!
Heave... ho!
Drop anchor!
Two/ six/ heave!
Two/ six/ heave!
This lad here knows the bottom of the sea the best!
This lad here knows the bottom of the sea the best!
He'll show you too!
There's still more!
You're done for!
C'mon/ anchor!
You won't dodge this one!
I'll smash you...
to flinders!
to flinders!
I'll use my anchor!
Weigh hey/ roll and... go!
Sink to the bottom!
One more hit!
You're doomed!
This is the captain speaking/ I'd like some support.
Attack them from the air!
Aye aye/ firing!
Oryaaaa!
Come here/ Palanquin Ship!
Palanquin Ship/ rise!
Enemy position confirmed/ firing!
You're doomed now!
This will make a big splash!
Anchors...
Anchors... aweigh!
Now/ come here...
I'll show you the bottom of the sea!
And now...
And now... you're through!
Come even deeper...
Only echoes will remain...
Sink down...
Sink down... into the briny depths!
Not a soul can hear us now...
I'm used to just waiting and seeing.
Best if I just keep watch a little longer.
I just can't attack at such distances.
Fleeing onto land/ are you?
I was dragging you down?!
This ship phantom now has some unfinished business with you!
Sorry to keep you waiting!
If you're going to rely on me/ I want to fulfill that trust.
I'll let myself be carried along in your wake!
Time for all hands!
Letting this slide would go against everything I've been taught.
No idling now!
Looks like you were in dire straits.
The enemy's still showing some signs of life.
I can't just loaf around in back!
Come on/ follow me!
That's some fine plotting from you!
We might as well give it our all.
I'll dash you with cold water!
This'll be plain sailing!
Just watch this!
With you and me together/ we'll navigate these stormy seas!
I'm not a saint like Hijiri/ I won't show them mercy!
I feel so free... and so powerful!
Yuyuko/ I... I wish I could have done better by you!
Yuyuko/ let's haunt the hell out of them!
We're ghost-mates/ we stick together!
We're ghost-mates/ we stick together!
Yuyuko/ are you three sheets to the wind or something?
How about I take the lead?
I'm not gonna leave all the work to Yuyuko!
Yuyuko/ I'll go first!
Yuyuko/ let's haunt the hell out of them!
Yuyuko/ I'll follow your lead.
Yuyuko/ together we can navigate these stormy seas!
Yuyuko/ let's haunt the hell out of them!
Yuyuko/ I feel full of strength!
Nazrin/ you'd do that for me?
Nazrin/ I'm gonna show them my stuff too!
I'll follow in Nazrin's wake!
Nazrin/ don't bite off more than you can chew!
Nazrin/ you okay?
Nazrin/ I'll go first!
Nazrin/ you can leave some of it for me.
Nazrin/ this is Hijiri's will!
It's a sure bet when I follow Nazrin's lead!
You sure you don't want to be with Shou?
Nazrin/ together we'll navigate these stormy seas!
Nazrin/ now's not the time for teaching Buddhism!
You look like you're pumped up too/ Nazrin!
... Ichirin/ I'm sorry.
Ichirin/ I'll handle it from here!
Now that's peculiar- Unzan's assault was too weak?
Ichirin/ don't get too fired up!
Ichirin/ don't go overboard!
Ichirin/ I want to take the lead for once.
Ichirin/ this is Hijiri's will!
Even Unzan looks pumped up!
Ichirin/ Unzan/ are you ready?
I'll follow your lead/ Ichirin!
Ichirin/ together we'll navigate these stormy seas!
Ichirin/ now's not the time for us to show the mercy of a Buddha!
With both of us committed/ we can weather this storm!
Wh-what should I do? Shou got taken out in my place...
Shou/ don't get in too deep!
That's not it/ Shou!
Shou/ you're not fighting alone out there!
Shou/ you're getting quite the collection of enemies.
Shou/ this is no time for idling!
This isn't how you do it/ Shou!
Shou/ follow me!
I'll follow Shou's instructions!
Making a path for a vessel's just part of being a captain.
Shou/ this too is to help fulfill Hijiri's goals!
Shou/ please let me handle this one.
Shou/ together we'll navigate these stormy seas!
Shou/ now's not the time for us to show the mercy of a Buddha!
Shou/ even you're getting keen on this/ aren't you?
Shou/ together we'll navigate these stormy seas!
I'll pull you under/ and get revenge for Hijiri!
Hijiri/ let me tidy things up!
Hijiri/ I'll follow after you!
Hijiri/ sit back and watch me handle this!
What are you trying to do to Hijiri?!
Hijiri/ you've been out of action for too long.
I won't let you lay a hand on Hijiri!
Are you even worthy of facing Hijiri?
You're going to get beaten by Hijiri and repent!
Hijiri/ I'll go first!
Hijiri/ I'll take point for you!
HIjiri/ allow me to head out alongside you.
We are sustained by Hijiri's faith!
The Palanquin Ship and I are with you/ Hijiri!
This is my vow!
... Nue/ I'm sorry.
Nue/ are you just playing around?
Nue/ I'll follow up!
You're in grave peril there/ Nue.
Nue/ don't push yourself too hard!
Nue/ stop playing around!
Nue/ I'll go first!
Are you ready/ Nue?!
Nue/ follow me!
Nue/ let's finish them off together!
Nue/ you're very keen on this fight/ aren't you!
Nue/ together we'll navigate these stormy seas!
Nue/ together we'll send them down into the cold dark!
I can't show my face to Hijiri after this...
It's not just the Palanquin Ship fighting!
Everyone/ leave the rest to me!
The skipper's heading in/ so cease fire!
I'm the captain of the Palanquin Ship!
I won't let you harm a single plank on her!
The Palanquin Ship is my anchor and my stronghold!
If you can't get around it/ you've just got to take it head-on!
No matter what stormy seas may confront me/ I'm ready!
You'll never sink my hopes!
I just want you to stop getting in the way!
Doesn't hurt to get hit by that.
Looks like you're not a first-rater.
That wasn't enough firepower.
You're not worthy of embarking on my ship.
My movements are barely enough!
Can I really win against them?!
I can't give up/ for Hijiri's sake!
If I take another hit...
And there's still so much left to do...
I've- I've still got things anchoring me to this world!
I guess I was being too pushy...
I let my guard down?!
That was way swifter than I thought it'd be!
What the―You can move like that?!
I've got to rally somehow/ and soon!
What the―What do you think you're doing?!
Oof/ you just don't quit...
Ugh/ if things don't change course...
Looks like I'm facing stiff opposition...
You're not gonna get me like that!
Now it's getting interesting!
That's the spirit!
You can do better than that!
There we go. Looks like I'm in this fight for the long haul!
These waves are nothing!
Even if you fire at random you can't hit me!
You won't get me in irons that easily!
I've found my feet for this one.
I can handle this much!
I hope the next one is just as smooth sailing.
I'm good at hiding from people.
Huh. Did someone hear something?
I've got a strong spirit!
Belay that!
To win this/ I've got to get a little heavy-handed...
Hiding signs of my approach is one of my specialties.
You've wandered too close to a ship phantom!
You're strong...
I've got no more heave in my ho...
They're strong. Still/ I think I did everything I could.
Sorry/ I've got to pull back for now.
Even though we need all hands on―
It's good to get in a bit of shore leave now and then.
With all of you/ it seems like this could be some good exercise!
Water being weak to lightning's just a superstition. I'll show you!
If you're a maiden from the celestial sea/ show me how you weather this storm!
Nue/ listen to me when I talk to you!
If you don't stop causing such a fuss/ then I'll...
I've got to catch you/ and quick!
Don't pretend I'll let you get away!
Could this have been us?
I don't want to see Hijiri like this!
Phantom or not/ I won't stand for this!
I'm not the sort who'd shy away from these kind of phantoms!
If you're that down in the dumps then I'll slap you back to your senses!
Oh/ now this one hits a little close to home.
Like I'd ever get like this!
It's now or never/ so allow me to knock your plans off-course!
You're getting annoying! To the bottom with you!
If you do things that way/ it'll be nothing but sorrow for you!
There's nothing to do but make you submit/ as fast as possible!
If you won't go down/ then I guess I have no choice.
Give back Gensokyo's dreams!
Your dreams are sunk/ right here and now!
I have a duty!\n I need to bring Hijiri back home to Gensokyo!
Give back the Dream World!
Your dreams are sunk/ right here and now!
I have a duty!\n I need to bring Hijiri back home to Gensokyo!
